summary: Reviewed all four candidate paths. The planner now skips retained records whose exact repository identity is absent from the current config set before resolving their per-record port or rewriting their custody, which removes the configured() throw that aborted matrix_plan. The added host regression test exercises the native matrix_plan host with removed, old-installation and unavailable-target records and asserts one in-scope cell, zero model calls and unchanged out-of-scope custody. The two test-only edits are consistent and introduce no runtime behavior change. No actionable defects found.

evidence: src/repair/loop-existing-pr.ts: releaseExistingPrHolds and reconcileExistingPrs now require configFor(deps, record.repository) to match, so retained records for removed repositories, old installations or currently unavailable targets are skipped before githubFor(record) reaches configured() in the matrix_plan path.

tests/host/matrix-actions-repository-scope_test.ts: runs runActionsMatrixHost for matrix_plan with three retained out-of-scope records and asserts a one-cell sentinel plan, modelCalls 0, unchanged record custody and one reservation, which is exactly the former aborting matrix_plan path.
tests/repair/existing-pr-hold-release_test.ts: supplies repairConfigs() so the new exact-identity scope check preserves the existing single-write release behavior for configured records.

tests/host/review-owner-custody_test.ts: stabilizes the interrupted-owner case by SIGKILLing after the running journal exists and asserting exit code 137; this is test-only and does not alter the matrix_plan fix.
